business_domains.notes: Top-ups credit the wallet with the REAL net (gross minus Stripe MX fee 3.6% + $3 + IVA), read from the charge's balance_transaction in confirm_payment_intent; formula is fallback only. /stripe/payment-intents/confirm accepts savePaymentMethod (persists card via sp_savedPaymentMethods) and sends a comprobante email (folio = stripeTransactions.transactionId) via modules.users._send_email in a daemon thread. Card-saving standalone flow: /automated-payments/setup-intent → save-method → saved-method.

Face liveness verification (4-direction challenge + blink detection, consistency/match distance thresholds) runs entirely client-side via @vladmandic/face-api in faceLiveness.ts — Azure Face API/Face-Liveness-With-Verify was removed from the backend and is no longer used anywhere. document_intelligence.py calls Azure AI Document Intelligence (prebuilt ID model, poll-based analyze) for INE/ID field extraction; Tesseract.js (idOcr.ts) is a client-side fallback OCR. signatureMatching.py does OpenCV (cv2) contour comparison between the ID's signature crop and the contract signature capture. geocoding.py is a thin httpx reverse-geocoding proxy used by the presence-capture step (latitude/longitude -> address).

Disbursements and withdrawals go SPEI-first (/payments/disburse: ledger debit → transfer to verified CLABE, auto-reverse on failure; STP is MOCK until the contract) with Stripe Connect Transfer as second rail. There is NO SPEI-in: a CLABE cannot be charged, so deposits are Stripe card charges until STP virtual CLABEs exist. Ledger = walletTransactions (idempotencyKey per attempt).

Azure Notification Hub installations tagged user_{userId} (NEVER clientId — backend maps clientId→userId) plus env_{appEnv} (dev/prod device flag). Sends always fire regardless of app state; FCM payload targets Android channel 'push_notifications' and carries data.navigationRoute for tap deep-links. NotificationDeliveries backs the in-app inbox (/myNotifications). Pending factory PRD: transactionNotification (per-channel money-movement confirmation record, pending→sent→confirmed via webhook) — tests/prd_transactionNotifications.json.
